title: Eza Meals: Crisis and contingency planning
stem:
All organizations and data in this question are fictional.

Eza Meals: Eza supplies chilled meals. A backup generator and alternate cold store would cost USD 18000 yearly. Power failures are infrequent but a long outage could spoil meals and interrupt vulnerable customers’ deliveries.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Define the term contingency planning.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage for Eza Meals of funding the proposed contingency plan.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Using the case information and relevant business management theory, recommend whether Eza Meals should proceed with funding the proposed contingency plan.

steps.text: Preparing in advance for possible disruptive events
by identifying risks, responsibilities and fallback actions before a crisis occurs.
Advantage: Prepared backup can reduce disruption and safety risk.
Applied consequence: Eza can protect food and deliveries during an outage.
Disadvantage: The plan uses scarce funds even when no outage occurs.
Applied consequence: USD 18000 cannot also be spent on routine service improvements.
Indicative support: Prepared backup can reduce disruption and safety risk because Eza can protect food and deliveries during an outage
Indicative counterargument: The plan uses scarce funds even when no outage occurs because USD 18000 cannot also be spent on routine service improvements

One defensible judgment: Fund proportionate backup after risk assessment and test responsibilities; compare shared storage options rather than treating all safeguards as equally necessary. Alternative recommendations earn full credit when supported by the case and a coherent response to the counterargument.

Evidence limitation: The probability and financial or human impact of a long outage are uncertain. Explain how this uncertainty affects confidence in the decision. Apply best fit: a theoretical-only answer can earn at most 4; without an explained case/stimulus limitation at most 8. Do not require all indicative points or award them separately.

bands.descriptor: No relevant response.
Limited relevant knowledge of funding the proposed contingency plan; arguments are mainly assertions and application to Eza Meals is absent or superficial.
